
DESCRIPTION
Create or update a local connection

USAGE
  one configure add [service-id] [--profile <name>] [flags]

SUBCOMMANDS
  container/acr  container/acr
  container/docker container/docker
  container/dockerhub container/dockerhub
  container/ghcr container/ghcr
  deploy/aliyun-oss deploy/aliyun-oss
  deploy/aws-s3  deploy/aws-s3
  deploy/cloudflare deploy/cloudflare
  deploy/edgeone deploy/edgeone
  deploy/kustomize deploy/kustomize
  deploy/minio   deploy/minio
  deploy/r2      deploy/r2
  deploy/rustfs  deploy/rustfs
  deploy/tencent-cos deploy/tencent-cos
  deploy/vercel  deploy/vercel
  env/infisical  env/infisical

TIPS
新增或更新一个 Profile。每个 Backend 的输入字段、默认值和敏感字段
都来自 Backend Catalog；无参 TTY 调用会先选择 Backend，非交互调用必须显式
指定 Backend 与 --profile。

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
